- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Auth Shift: Move account sign-in to take place immediately after the pet adoption certificate screen so users sign in to safeguard their newly created pet. (why: 8 support tickets mention pets missing or reset after signing in, indicating sign-in before pet adoption confuses users about account binding.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Dual-Photo Quality Preview Verification Flow: Introduce a photo verification flow on the photo upload screen with real-time subject cropping preview and instant quality diagnostic badges. (why: 3 support tickets report custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results during creation.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Cloud Sync Data Safety Warning: Display an explicit account data protection hint on sign-in warning users to sign in with the correct existing profile to prevent pet resets. (why: 8 support emails complained about lost or reset pet profiles after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Animated Pet Desktop Spawn Loading Bar: Rebuild the waiting screen with a centered spotlight layout, dynamic progress bar, and estimated time display while spawning the pet. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s and support received 3 bug reports about pets failing to show up on desktop.)
4: [home, notification] System Tray Pet Spawning Desktop Notification: Enable background ready notifications and prompt users on the waiting screen when their pet is fully rendered on the desktop. (why: Waiting step drop-off and high mean time (2336s) suggest users step away while waiting and lose track of pet desktop launch.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Framing Guidelines Card: Add photo framing requirements checklist to the photo upload screen explaining optimal pet pose and lighting. (why: Support receives 3 emails regarding custom pet generation failures and strange rendering output.)

scores.note: High support ticket evidence; shifting auth post-adoption aligns with value-first onboarding but requires flow changes.
Targeting 32.1% adoption drop-off, but complex multi-step preview verification flow may introduce user friction.

Visual progress indicator directly addresses the huge 2336s mean wait time at home step, requires screen redesign.
Desktop notifications re-engage users stepping away during long 2336s spawn times; needs OS integration.
Low-cost guidance card targeting adoption drop-off, helping users provide better pet photos.
